correctness.rationale: For B=P¹×P¹, the bidegree-(2,2) family F=a(u0²+u1²)(v0²+v1²)+b(u0²−u1²)(v0²−v1²)+4c u0u1v0v1 is invariant under the two diagonal PGL2 involutions induced by R=diag(1,−1) and S=swap. Their GL2 lifts anticommute on each factor but commute as R⊗R and S⊗S, so O_B(1,1) and the parent P_B(O⊕O(1,1)) admit a genuine Klein-four action while O_B(1,0) does not linearize. Independent SymPy calculation verifies projection discriminant 4[(b²−a²)(u⁴+1)+(4c²−2a²−2b²)u²], and at [1:2:3] it is 4(3u⁴+26u²+3) with 640 nonzero quadratic discriminant: smooth genus-one double cover. Picard generators of the blowup are h1,h2,tautological,exceptional; h1+h2 and last two linearize. The negative section survives disjointly, and restricting a hypothetical h1 linearization yields impossible commuting 2×2 lifts. Hence Am(X,G)=Z/2 for every smooth invariant center in the stated nonempty locus. Geometry of Fano family 4.2 rests on the cited Mori–Mukai blowup classification, not merely numerical verifier output.
